text:
eva: FYI, helm upgrade for gpupool (chart v2.4.0 -> v2.5.0) in eu-west-1 is hung, pre-delete hook job 'gpupool-migrate' pending ImagePullBackOff :worried:

michael: ugh. deploy-bot shows hook failed, but helm is waiting so the release is locked. can you paste kubectl describe?

sre-oncall: deploying to eu-west needed a registry secret sync yesterday — did we miss that rollout?

eva: here's describe output:
```
Name:           gpupool-migrate
Namespace:      gpupool-system
Status:         Failed
Reason:         PodFailed
Message:        pods "gpupool-migrate-xyz" is waiting: Failed to pull image "registry.redwood.ai/gpupool-migrate:2026-03-18"
Events:
  Normal  Scheduled  2m  default-scheduler  Successfully assigned gpupool-system/gpupool-migrate-xyz to ip-10-0-12-34.eu-west-1.compute.internal
  Warning Failed     10s  kubelet            Failed to pull image "registry.redwood.ai/gpupool-migrate:2026-03-18": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Error response from daemon: pull access denied for registry.redwood.ai/gpupool-migrate
```

ana: that error is classic missing imagePullSecret. we rotated the registry creds in us-east and forgot to propagate the secret to eu-west AWS account when we added the new org infra.

marco: quick options: 1) add imagePullSecret to the gpupool-system namespace in eu-west 2) patch the hook job image to a public fallback tag 3) rollback helm release to v2.4.0 (revert) — which do we want?

michael: can we patch the job so the release unblocks without rolling back? helm waits until hooks finish or fail, but if we manually delete the job/hook pod helm will mark the hook failed and the release will continue (but that could leave resources in a bad state).

sre-oncall: safest short-term: create the imagePullSecret in eu-west from vault creds and restart the job. i'll do it now.

sre-oncall: running:
```
kubectl create secret docker-registry redwood-regcred -n gpupool-system \
  --docker-server=registry.redwood.ai \
  --docker-username=redwood-bot \
  --docker-password=$(vault kv get -field=password secret/registry/eu-west) \
  --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
```

sre-oncall: secret created and pod restarted, pods are now pulling image...

deply-bot: deploy-bot: Hook 'pre-delete gpupool-migrate' failed previously, retrying hook execution as part of helm upgrade.

eva: looks like image pulled successfully, job started migration script logs show "migrating 42 CRs"

michael: thanks. can we also add a preflight check in the release pipeline that validates image pull in target region before running hooks? this escape is happening too often.

ana: +1. we should also add a gitops health check that validates imagePullSecrets exist in each region before promoting chart changes.

marco: opened infra-ticket INFRA-893: "Ensure registry secrets are present in all regions before helm upgrades" and added a note to the release playbook to run `kubectl get secret redwood-regcred -n gpupool-system` as a preflight.

eva: rollout completed, helm reported upgrade SUCCESS after hook finished. will follow up with a PR to the pipeline preflight job. :white_check_mark:
